entities.name: Saccharomyces cerevisiae NUG1
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to the analyzed 520-residue protein; Swiss-Prot accession P40010.
Nuclear GTPase required for 60S ribosomal subunit export to the cytoplasm.
Localized to the nucleus and nucleolus, and associated with the large-subunit preribosome.
Annotated for GTP binding, GTPase activity, and RNA/mRNA binding.
Contains a CP-type G domain around residues 165–343; N-terminal region is basic and disordered.
Pfam matches: GN3L_Grn1 at residues 13–88 and MMR_HSR1 at residues 283–371.

entities.name: 60S ribosomal subunit export
observations: NUG1 participates in export of the pre-60S ribosomal subunit from the nucleus to the cytoplasm.
The associated preribosome and nucleolar localization support a role during late ribosome biogenesis.

entities.name: Large-subunit rRNA maturation
observations: NUG1 is annotated in maturation of the large-subunit rRNA from the tricistronic rRNA precursor.
Related fungal homolog Grn1 supports a conserved role in pre-rRNA processing and large-subunit preribosome assembly.
